explore_prose: Every run in this experiment is in the explorer below: filter by outcome to see which settings held the SLOs, or by setting to compare one sweep against another.
Each sweep's hypothesis was written before the runs, and is quoted beside that sweep's measured result below.

hero.html: 190 configurations over 3 sweeps (colocated, pd-dp1, pd-always), each at 5 load levels, every run on exactly 64 GPUs.
8x TP4xDP2 + EP (batch tokens 32,768), from the colocated sweep, reached 56.02 tok/s/accelerator (3585.1 tok/s across the fleet) at concurrency 64 while holding the scenario's SLOs.
8x TP4xDP2 + EP (batch tokens 32,768) at concurrency 64. 354 of 950 runs held the SLOs.

recommendation_prose: The table below ranks the measured operating points by output tok/s per accelerator, the objective this experiment selects on, among runs that held the scenario's SLOs.

prose: The colocated control should hold ITL only with a chunked-prefill cap, and the wide-dp shapes should give the most tokens per GPU.
Measured: best was 8x TP4xDP2 + EP (batch tokens 32,768) at 56.02 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 64).
sections.title: Sweep: colocated

prose: Prefill-heavy ratios should win on 10k prompts, and a threshold near the median prompt should beat splitting every request.
Measured: best was 2P/6D TP8 + EP at 39.53 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 32).
sections.title: Sweep: pd-dp1

prose: Splitting every request should cost ITL headroom against the threshold arms, because each handoff stalls a decode slot.
Measured: best was 4P/4D TP8 + EP at 38.63 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 32).
